subject: Acme Corp — Evaluation kickoff & trial plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-corp.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps: Redwood eval

Hi Jordan / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier — really appreciated the context on Acme's search and recommendation workflows. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we can get the evaluation kicked off: 

- Recap: primary objective is to reduce recommendation latency and cut per-request embedding costs while keeping relevance at parity. You run ~200k requests/day across the storefront and pilot search.
- Success criteria (high level): 30% reduction in per-request cost or equivalent TCO win; P95 latency under 120ms for key endpoints; no regression on the top-100 prompt set.
- Proposed kickoff agenda (30-45m): trial plan overview, success criteria & metrics, prompt set/eval plan, technical deep-dive (integration points / data flows), next steps & timeline.

Would love to schedule a 45-min evaluation kickoff next week. My initial availability (PST):
- Tue 4/27 10:00-10:45
- Wed 4/28 11:00-11:45
- Thu 4/29 14:00-14:45

Connor (cc'd) is our solutions engineer and will run the technical portion. Neha from CS will join the rollout/operations discussion. Attached is a short draft agenda and a starter trial plan we can iterate on.

Attachments: acme-eval-kickoff-agenda.pdf (stub), acme-trial-plan.xlsx (stub)

If those times don't work, send 2-3 alternatives and we'll align.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: Redwood eval

Thanks Marissa — this is great, and the goals map nicely to what we discussed.

We can do Tue 4/27 at 10:00 PT. I'll be joined by Priya (platform lead) and one engineer (Tariq) — would it make sense for Connor to keep the deep-dive to 20-25 minutes so Tariq can ask integration questions?

Also, curious if there are any prerequisite items you want from us ahead of the kickoff (sample prompts, data schema, non-prod endpoints)?

Jordan
Director of Product, Acme Corp

Jordan — for prerequisites, the most helpful items are:

- Short description of current infra (non-prod endpoints, auth model)
- Any hard latency SLOs we should be aware of beyond the ones above

If you can share those before EOD Monday that gives us time to tailor the eval. I've attached the kickoff agenda (one-pager) and the starter trial plan spreadsheet.

Thanks — I'll send a calendar invite shortly with the agenda and a conference link.

Marissa
